basics.name: Zehao Dang
basics.summary: Computer Engineering student at Virginia Tech (Control, Robotics and Autonomy concentration) working on vision-based adaptive 3D printing, robotic additive manufacturing, and autonomous ground-vehicle simulation.

work.name: Grado Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering, Virginia Tech
work.summary: Leading a vision-based adaptive 3D-printing system for dynamically deforming surfaces and a robotic additive manufacturing pipeline for the UR5e, validated in NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
highlights: Leading the development of a vision-based adaptive 3D-printing system for dynamically deforming surfaces, integrating mechanical design, prototyping, Raspberry Pi control, computer vision and predictive feedback control; targeting submission to NAMRC 2027.

Led a team of 4 undergraduate researchers to develop an end-to-end robotic additive manufacturing pipeline converting Cura G-code into UR5e trajectories using inverse kinematics, redundancy-aware path optimization, and trajectory retiming, with simulation validation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim.

work.name: Hi-Tech Optoelectronics Co., Ltd.
work.summary: Inspected semiconductor laser chip modules for manufacturing defects and assembled and tested power-supply units for diode-pumped laser systems.
highlights: Inspected semiconductor laser chip modules under optical microscopes to identify manufacturing defects and verify product quality. Supported production-line operations by assembling and testing power-supply units for diode-pumped laser systems.

experience.name: AutoNav Team, VT CRO (Advisor: Dr. Matt Nowinski)
experience.summary: Building a ROS2/Gazebo simulation environment for an autonomous ground vehicle competing in the 34th Intelligent Ground Vehicle Competition (IGVC).
highlights: Building a ROS2/Gazebo simulation environment for an autonomous ground vehicle competing in the 34th Intelligent Ground Vehicle Competition (IGVC) in June 2027, including sensor simulation and navigation-stack validation.
Developing reproducible test scenarios to evaluate localization, path planning, and obstacle-avoidance algorithms.

experience.name: Math Department, Sichuan University - Pittsburgh Institute (PI: Dr. Zheng Yang)
experience.summary: Evaluated machine-learning models for Alzheimer's disease classification and contributed to manuscript writing.
highlights: Assisted in evaluating machine-learning models for AD, MCI, and NC classification by comparing test accuracy across classifiers.
Conducted literature review on machine-learning-based Alzheimer's disease classification and contributed to manuscript writing.

experience.name: ECE Department, Sichuan University - Pittsburgh Institute (PI: Dr. Jeungphill Hanne)
experience.summary: Reviewed analytical methods for infrared thermography-based bone-fracture diagnosis and coordinated team research-paper presentations.
highlights: Conducted a literature review of analytical methods for infrared thermography-based bone-fracture diagnosis. Coordinated biweekly research-paper presentations for a team of six undergraduate researchers.
